messages:
maria: quick check — PR #1588 is functionally ready but GH actions showed a couple style nits. I ran unit tests locally and they pass. Can someone eyeball the small formatting/name fixes before I merge?

alex: I looked — main thing is a naming inconsistency in src/serve/pipeline.py: `requestID` vs project snake_case. tiny rename + update a couple tests and we're good.

jamal: also spotted a `long_string` line > 120 chars in `prompts/defaults.py` that ruff/black splits differently depending on versions. run `pre-commit run --all-files` or `python -m black . && ruff check --fix .` should normalize.

lee: if you push the `request_id` rename and run pre-commit I'll approve. prefer a single commit (squash) so CI history is clean. can do post-merge bump if you need to keep history though. :+1:

ci-bot: CI report — checks: unit-tests: passed, static-checks: failed (ruff: E501 line too long), typecheck: passed, docker-build: queued

maria: thanks — pushing a tiny fix now. will run pre-commit hooks locally and force-push the branch.

alex: one more nit — in `kvcache` tests you renamed a var from `ctx` -> `context` in one spot but left `ctx` in the helper docstring. trivial but CI will flag.

maria: good catch, updating that too. also adding a short note in the PR describing the format change so reviewers know it isn't functional.

lee: ping me after you push and I'll approve and merge during the next merge window (we're in a short freeze until 15:00 UTC).

jamal: fyi if black/ruff disagree on wrapping you can add a `# fmt: off` around the weird multiline + a short comment, then follow up with a quick reformat commit — but prefer to align with repo defaults.

maria: pushed fixes, pre-commit passed locally. force-pushed at 1912346705.

ci-bot: CI report (rerun) — unit-tests: passed, static-checks: passed, typecheck: passed, docker-build: passed.

lee: approving now. merging after 15:00 UTC slot. :rocket:

alex: thanks!

maria: thanks everyone :heart: — will follow up in PR with the small changelog entry.
